argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$h=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:17450/' -TimeoutSec 3
Write-Output ('DASHBOARD_HTTP='+$h.StatusCode)
Write-Output ('DASHBOARD_HAS_TITLE='+$h.Content.Contains('Живые чаты и задачи агентов'))
Write-Output ('DASHBOARD_HAS_5SEC_REFRESH='+$h.Content.Contains('setInterval(refresh,5000)'))
Write-Output ('DASHBOARD_BYTES='+$h.RawContentLength)
$api=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:17450/api/live' -TimeoutSec 3
Write-Output ('API_CONTRACT='+$api.contract)
Write-Output ('API_READONLY='+$api.readOnly)
Write-Output ('API_SCAN_COMPLETE='+$api.scanComplete)
Write-Output ('OPEN_CHATS='+$api.openCount)
Write-Output ('UNREGISTERED='+$api.unregisteredOpenCount)
Write-Output ('ASSIGNMENTS='+@($api.assignments).Count)
Write-Output ('BRIDGE_17448_LISTENS='+[bool](Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 17448 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue))

note: Read-only final HTTP check of local R68 live HTML and API, no provider action or process mutations.
